text: # Prepaid Tariff Catalogue — H2 2026 **Document ID:** TARIFF_PREPAID_2026H2 **Category:** C02 — Plans & Subscriptions **Department:** Product **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-05-27 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Plan Table | Plan | Price (₹) | Validity | Data/day | Voice | SMS/day | |---|---:|---|---|---|---| | Value Combo 199 | 199 | 28 days | 1GB | Unlimited | 100 | | Value Combo 299 | 299 | 28 days | 2GB | Unlimited | 100 | | Value Combo 599 | 599 | 56 days | 2GB | Unlimited | 100 | | Annual 1999 | 1,999 | 365 days | 1.5GB | Unlimited | 100 | | Data Booster 61 | 61 | 1 day | 2GB (add-on) | — | — | ## Eligibility & Activation - Available to new and existing customers within the relevant customer scope (prepaid/postpaid/enterprise). - Activation is instant on successful payment via the app, self-care portal, or an authorised retail outlet. ## Fair Usage Policy (FUP) On exhausting the daily/period data allowance, speeds are reduced to the FUP rate for the remainder of that period; unlimited voice remains unaffected. See KB_C09_fup_data_speed for details. ## Roaming Domestic roaming is included at no extra charge. International roaming requires a separate add-on pack; see the roaming category documentation. ## Renewal & Cancellation - Plans can be renewed manually or via auto-renew (where enabled) before or on the expiry date. - Cancellation before validity expiry does not entitle a pro-rata refund
